text:
Alex: Heads-up — CI on main is red for ARM cross builds. Bazel target //runtime/engine:engine_link failing during final link step. Anyone on call for a quick triage?

CI-bot: [ci] Build failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/89234 (exit code 1) — triggered by commit 0d4e5f6

Maria: Reproduced locally using our cross image `redwood/cross-arm:2026-03`. Link error looks like missing atomic symbols. Snippet: 
```
/usr/bin/ld: .../libengine.a(engine.o): in function `atomic_inc':
engine.cpp:(.text+0x1f): undefined reference to `__atomic_fetch_add_8'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
Target //runtime/engine:engine_link (failed)
```

Jamal: @Alex @Maria likely libatomic not pulled into the sysroot or the toolchain link flags dropped `-latomic`. We recently changed cc_toolchain_config in 0d4e5f6 — that commit touched linker flags. Can someone bisect to confirm?

Alex: Last green on main was 0a1b2c3, first red is 0d4e5f6 (both recent). @Jamal can you take a quick bisect? If it's the linker flags we should be able to hotfix with a linkopt.

Phil: I touched the toolchain flags in 0d4e5f6 to attempt to fix stack protector behavior on qemu; didn't intend to remove -latomic though. I'll double-check my diff.

Jamal: Doing a quick bisect now — running `git bisect start ; git bisect bad 0d4e5f6 ; git bisect good 0a1b2c3` and will run `bazel build --config=arm_qemu //runtime/engine:engine_link` on each.

SRE-Bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/89234/retry (authorized)

Maria: For a faster workaround, locally I added `--linkopt=-latomic` and the binary links and tests run. Not a full solution but unblocks devs.

Alex: OK — short plan: 1) @Jamal bisects to confirm culprit commit 2) if it's the flag removal, open PR to add `linker_flag: "-latomic"` to cc_toolchain_config and run canary; 3) SRE will rerun CI for the PR.

Jamal: Bisect done — culprit is 0d4e5f6. It removed `linker_flag: "-latomic"` from toolchain config accidentally. I'll open a tiny PR to restore it (w/ changelog + test).

Phil: Oof sorry, my bad — slipped in a cleanup and dropped that line. PR approved once CI green, will monitor. :facepalm:

Alex: Thanks everyone. @CI-bot please tag the PR build as high priority.

CI-bot: Tag applied: priority=high, build queued for PR 1762

Maria: After the PR merge, I verified canary build passes on qemu and cargo/native integration tests. All green locally. :thumbsup:

Alex: Closing the thread — follow-up task: add a simple link-test to our cross-toolchain CI matrix to catch missing libatomic in future. Assigned to Jamal and Phil.
